name: simulate-expense-sepp-boundaries
why: Measured reach for the five annual expense and SEPP boundaries extracted from simulatePlan. Each helper entry pins the complete executable helper body, and each paired callsite entry pins the complete caller-side consumption band, including ordered folds and effect publication. The nine dedicated J/K block members run in all four equivalence modes. Reach reports cold sub-line operands separately; entry notes distinguish those branch-level gaps from whole-line reach.

entries.label: annual lifestyle-layer selection and arithmetic
entries.note: The corpus reaches fixed and ABW modes, stable phase ordering, couple/survivor/no-survivor scaling, optional lifestyle layers, ordered portfolio folding, and the planning-age horizon. The sole cold sub-line region is line 80's `?? 0`: the annual pass builds startOfYearBalance from every balance row before this call, so a helper balance without a corresponding map entry is a defensive structural-input case rather than a reachable validated-simulator case.

entries.label: annual lifestyle helper invocation and result consumption
annual insurance-premium row production
entries.note: The corpus reaches paid-up, lifetime, until-age, alive/dead subject, and LTC-owner versus life-insured paths while preserving policy order; reach reports no cold whole lines or sub-line regions in this helper range.

entries.label: annual property carrying-cost row production
entries.note: The corpus reaches alive and all-dead years, non-property skips, pre-sale and sale-year paths, duplicate ids, omitted cost fields, and both cost operands. The sole cold sub-line region is line 43's `?? null`: the dedicated projection members use owned properties, while the helper unit suite covers the supported ownerless-property record shape.

entries.label: annual expense-summary assembly
entries.note: A dedicated member makes every monetary expense channel nonzero and exercises all lifestyle and goal layers, including the cancellation-sensitive care-cost-minus-LTC-benefit order.

entries.label: annual SEPP operation planning
entries.note: The corpus reaches owned IRA and employer-plan rows, inherited S2 pre/post-election gating, active and inactive series, accepted and refused separation boundaries, RMD and amortization methods, new and reused amortization cache values, duplicate ids, distribution and sub-cent suppression paths, and deferred IRA character. Four cold sub-line regions remain: line 104's primary-owner fallback and line 170's corresponding raw null owner are supported ownerless-account shapes covered by helper tests; line 106's dead-owner `continue` is a branch-level corpus gap; line 124's zero fallback is defensive because the annual pass constructs startOfYearBalance from every balance row before calling the helper. Every physical line containing those operands is nevertheless reached.

entries.label: SEPP operation application and effect publication
entries.note: The corpus reaches cache writes and distributions, ordered balance mutation, runtime occurrence/application publication, annual cash-flow indexing, and deferred Form 8606 character. Any optional-chain or compound-condition gaps reported by JavaScript coverage are cold sub-line regions rather than cold whole lines.

readingTheCounts: A member count proves that at least one line in the named range executed. The reach command additionally fails on any cold executable whole line inside a reached range. JavaScript line coverage cannot distinguish every nullish, ternary, optional-chain, or compound-condition operand sharing a physical line, so the report's cold sub-line regions and the notes above must be read alongside the focused helper and delegation tests.
